questions.question: What will be the net discount (in percentage) after two successive discounts of 50% and 50%?
questions.solution:
Given:

The successive discount are 50% and 50%.

Formula used:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

Where,

X = First discount

Y = Second discount

Calculation:

Successive discount = X + Y - (XY)/100

X = 50%, Y = 50%

⇒ 50 + 50 - 2500/100

⇒ 75%

∴ The single equivalent discount is 75%.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f72be33799c08d3322a2907949d25e7543e352bc7880a277f6efed7f62d7c04b.png] 

Let the MP be x

⇒ Initial SP after 50% discount = x - 0.5x = 0.5x

⇒ Final SP after 50% discount = 0.5x - 0.5 × 0.5x = 0.5x - 0.25x = 0.25x

∴ Net discount = {{MP-Final SP}}{{MP}} ×100=frac{{x-0.25x}}{x} ×100=75\%

The average age of Rustam and Preetam is 39 years. The average age of Preetam and Geetam is 28 years. The average age of Rustam and Geetam is 34 years. What will be the age (in years) of the youngest of the three after 10 years?
questions.solution:
Let the ages of Rustam, Preetam and Geetam be r, p and g respectively.

Given: (r + p)/2 = 39 ⇒ r + p = 78 ----(1)

⇒ (p + g)/2 = 28 ⇒ p + g = 56 ----(2)

⇒ (r + g)/2 = 34 ⇒ r + g = 68 ----(3)

Substituting the value of p and g in terms of r from (1) and (3) in (2):

⇒ 78 - r + 68 - r = 56

⇒ 146 - 2r = 56

⇒ 2r = 146 - 56 = 90

∴ r = 45

⇒ p = 78 - 45 = 33 and g = 68 - 45 = 23

∴ Youngest is Geetam of 23 years.

∴ Geetam’s age after 10 years = 23 + 10 = 33 years.

questions.question: The average age of 6 members of a family is 25 years. If the youngest member of the family is 15 years old, then what was the average age (in years) of the family at the time of the birth of the youngest member?
questions.solution:
Average age of 6 members of family = 25

⇒ Sum of ages of all presently = 25 × 6 = 150

Youngest member of the family = 15 years

At the time of the birth of the youngest member, everyone would be 15 years younger and there will be five members only.

⇒ Required average = frac{{Sum of ages of 5 members}}{5}

Now, sum of 5 members = Sum of 6 members - (6 × 15) = Sum of 6 members - 90

⇒ Sum of 5 members = 150 - 90 = 60

∴ Required Average = 60/5 = 12

questions.question: A car left 3 minutes early than the scheduled time and in order to reach the destination 126 km away in time, it has to slow its speed by 6 km/h from the usual. What is the usual speed (in km/hr) of the car?
questions.solution:
Let the usual speed of the car be ‘x’.

Time taken to travel 126 km at x speed = 126/x = t ----(1)

New time = t + (3/60) = t + (1/20) hours

New speed = x - 6 km/hr

⇒ 126 = ( {t + (1)/({20)}} ) times ( {x - 6} )

Substituting from (1):

begin{array}{l}
Rightarrow xt = frac{{20t + 1}}{{20}} times ( {x - 6} )\\
Rightarrow 20xt = 20xt + x - 120t - 6
end{array} 

⇒ x = 120t + 6

⇒ t = (x - 6)/120 ----(2)

Substituting (2) in (1):

begin{array}{l}
Rightarrow frac{{126}}{x} = frac{{x - 6}}{{120}} Rightarrow 15120 = {x²} - 6x\\
Rightarrow {x²} - 6x - 15120 = 0\\
Rightarrow {x²} - 126x + 120x - 15120 = 0 Rightarrow x( {x - 126} ) + 120( {x - 126} ) = 0\\
Rightarrow ( {x - 126} )( {x + 120} ) = 0
end{array} 

∴ x = 126 km/hr (∵ x can’t be negative)

questions.question: If a certain sum becomes 3 times in 6 years at compound interest, then in how many years, it will become 81 times?
questions.solution:
Let P be the principal amount.

After 6 years of compound interest:

Sum = 3P

Let’s suppose after n years the sum is 81P

Now, 81P is 4th power of 3P.

⇒ It’ll take 4 times 6 years for the sum to become 81 times.

∴ n = 6 × 4 = 24 years.

questions.question: A chord of length 7 cm subtends an angle of 60° at the centre of a circle. What is the radius (in cm) of the circle?
questions.solution:
**Explanation -**

Since a chord is subtending angle at the centre, the other angles of the triangle formed by chord and the centre will be same as two sides opposing it will be same (both are radii of the circle).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/17229391d9a7db50ba3d4c83119ea4f360deaba8db25d1b47e2b96af91873fea.png] 

⇒ Sum of angles of a triangle = 180°

⇒ 60 + x + x = 180°

⇒ 2x = 120°

∴ x = 60°

∴ All angles of the triangle are equal → The triangle is an equilateral triangle.

∴ Radius of the circle = side of the triangle = 7 cm
